description_for_human: Suche und kuratierte Prozessunterstützung für Cernion Energy: Unternehmen, VDMI, ZNP, Netzanschluss.
description_for_model:
Use this plugin to search Cernion energy management data and to execute curated, safety-controlled process workflows.

The plugin exposes ONLY allowlisted operations from config/copilot-operations.json — all other API endpoints are blocked. Phase 2: read and draft actions only. No direct write or execute actions are available — those are deferred to Phase 3.

SEARCH: searchCernionData — cross-domain entity search.

READ-ONLY CONTEXT: getVdmiContext, listOpenResponsibilities, getZnpProjectStatus, getGridConnectionValidation, vdmi_context, vdmi_myResponsibilities, vdmi_findings, vdmi_dossier, znp_listProjects, znp_getProjectMeta, znp_getProjectAssets, gridConnectionList, gridConnectionGet, vdmiFindingsList, connectionRejectionEvidenceList, connectionRejectionEvidenceGet.

DRAFT (no writes, no side effects): prepareVdmiValidation, draftVdmiEvidence, prepareGridConnectionValidation.

SAFETY RULES:
- Always load context before any draft action.
- Summarise target, intended change, and risk BEFORE calling a draft action.
- NEVER call delete, override, signature, final-approval, or any write/execute actions — they are not in this plugin.
- NEVER invent operations not listed here.

functions.name: askCernionAgent
functions.description: Ask Cernion for compact evidence, process context, risks, open questions and next steps. Read-only; Copilot composes the final answer.

functions.name: searchCernionData
functions.description: Search across Cernion energy entities (companies, VNBs, VDMI matrices, ZNP projects, grid connection validations, EDM MeLo IDs). Returns id, title, excerpt, type, status, and url for each hit.

functions.name: getVdmiContext
functions.description: Load full VDMI matrix context: status, open task count, nomination state, evidence count. Call before any VDMI process action.

functions.name: listOpenResponsibilities
functions.description: List VDMI matrices where the current user or a named actor has open Verantwortlich tasks.

functions.name: getZnpProjectStatus
functions.description: Get ZNP project metadata and graph statistics (nodes, edges, layers). Read-only.

functions.name: getGridConnectionValidation
functions.description: Retrieve a grid connection validation report: decision, findings count, grid operator. Read-only.

functions.name: prepareVdmiValidation
functions.description: Prepare a VDMI matrix nomination draft. No writes. requiredConfirmation: true. Present summary and confirmationMessage to user before proceeding.

functions.name: draftVdmiEvidence
functions.description: Draft evidence suggestions for open VDMI matrix tasks. No writes, requiredConfirmation: false. Returns per-task suggestions.

functions.name: prepareGridConnectionValidation
functions.description: Prepare a grid connection validation config draft. No writes. requiredConfirmation: true. Present confirmationMessage before executing.

functions.name: vdmi_context
functions.description: Get active VDMI matrix context for a running process job. Read-only.

functions.name: vdmi_myResponsibilities
functions.description: List VDMI matrices where the authenticated caller holds a Verantwortlich responsibility. Read-only.

functions.name: vdmi_findings
functions.description: List VDMI governance findings for the current tenant. Read-only.

functions.name: vdmiFindingsList
functions.description: List VDMI governance findings scoped to a specific tenant (multi-tenant path). Read-only.

functions.name: vdmi_dossier
functions.description: Get condensed decision dossier for a VDMI task (Verantwortlich role view). Read-only.

functions.name: znp_listProjects
functions.description: List all active ZNP workspace projects in memory. Read-only.

functions.name: znp_getProjectMeta
functions.description: Get ZNP project metadata and graph statistics by project ID. Read-only.

functions.name: znp_getProjectAssets
functions.description: List Layer 0 MaStR assets loaded into a ZNP project. Read-only.

functions.name: gridConnectionList
functions.description: List past grid connection validation reports, newest first. Optionally filter by grid operator ID. Read-only.

functions.name: gridConnectionGet
functions.description: Get a specific grid connection validation report including all findings. Read-only.

functions.name: connectionRejectionEvidenceList
functions.description: List connection rejection evidence packages. Read-only.

functions.name: connectionRejectionEvidenceGet
functions.description: Get a connection rejection evidence package by ID. Read-only.

functions.name: prepareVdmiEvidence
functions.description: Prepare a VDMI evidence injection intent. Creates a persistent ProcessExecutionIntent — no writes. requiredConfirmation: true. Present intentId and confirmationMessage to user. Execute outside Copilot via executeProcessIntent.

functions.name: prepareZnpAssumption
functions.description: Prepare a ZNP planning assumption intent. Creates a persistent ProcessExecutionIntent — no writes. requiredConfirmation: true.

functions.name: prepareConnectionRejectionEvidence
functions.description: Prepare a connection rejection evidence package intent. Creates a persistent ProcessExecutionIntent — no writes. requiredConfirmation: true.

functions.name: getProcessIntent
functions.description: Get a process execution intent by ID. Returns intent status, payload summary, and audit trail. Read-only.

functions.name: listProcessIntents
functions.description: List process execution intents. Filter by operationFamily or status. Read-only.
